description: Caption says the recipe is in the comments; the user added the creator's comment

payload.source_text: Best focaccia of my life 😍 recipe in the comments!
top_comments: RECIPE: 500g bread flour, 400g water, 10g salt, 7g yeast, olive oil. Mix, rest overnight in the fridge, stretch into a pan, dimple with oil and bake at 230C for 25 minutes.
